title: Running creators on WhatsApp: five rules and a tracker
hook: Creator work on WhatsApp goes wrong in the same few places. Five rules fix them.
caption:
Creator work on WhatsApp goes wrong in the same few places. Five rules fix them.

The brief gets buried, feedback comes from more than one person, and nobody is sure which file is final.

You do not need a new tool for this. Use one group per creator per campaign, one pinned brief, one person giving numbered feedback, versioned file names, and a one-tab tracker outside the chat.

The full system is on the last slide. Save it and send it to whoever manages your creators.

Follow @galvor.ai.

slides.headline: Running creators on WhatsApp? *Five rules* that keep it in order
slides.sub: No new tool needed. Set these up once.

slides.headline: The chat is *fast*. Finding things in it is slow.
slides.body:
The brief gets buried under voice notes, and feedback arrives from more than one person.

By the end, nobody is sure which file is final.

slides.headline: One group, *one pinned brief*
items: One group per creator per campaign
The brief is a single message, pinned
A change is a new pinned message marked v2

slides.headline: One voice, *one round* at a time
items: Feedback is one message, with numbered points
Each point carries the time in the video

slides.headline: Name files so *final means final*
items: The approved cut is renamed FINAL with the date
Only FINAL files go to the media buyer

slides.headline: A *one-tab tracker* does the remembering
items: Status: briefed, shot, in review, approved, live
A link to the FINAL file

slides.headline: The *WhatsApp creator system*
items: One group per creator per campaign

slides.headline: Keep WhatsApp. *Add the rules.*
slides.sub: Save this and send it to your creator manager.
